verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a payments platform made up of terminals, the Terminal API and a Customer Area. It has no agent or LLM runtime that would act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in servers, so the client-side axis is a category error for this product type. The documented Adyen MCP server is the opposite (server) role and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
